combos.name: Rebel Combo Set - Professional Hair Clipper & Hair Trimmer
combos.contents: Rebel cordless clipper (4 tight dub magnetic guards 1/16"-1/4", charging stand) plus Rebel trimmer (charging stand), each with micro-USB cord, zero-gap/mini screwdriver tools and cleaning kit.
features: Super-torque rotary clipper motor up to 7,200 RPM
Trimmer motor up to 7,500 SPM
Black Diamond Faper fixed blade + deep tooth slim cutter (clipper)
X-Pro Wide fixed blade + "The One" cutter (trimmer)
Up to 180 min runtime, micro-USB charging
Click, spring-click or freestyle taper

combos.name: Super Set - Rebel Hair Clipper & Flex Cordless Hair Trimmer
combos.contents: Rebel cordless clipper with 4 double magnetic guards (#0-#2) and Flex cordless trimmer with 3 combs (1.5/4.5/6 mm), packed in a small travel case with micro-USB cords and adaptors.
features: Super-torque rotary clipper motor up to 7,200 RPM
Gold Titanium Faper fixed blade + Black Diamond slim deep tooth cutter
Flex trimmer: Gold Titanium X-Pro Classic blade + "The One" DLC cutter
Includes travel case
Micro-USB charging, worldwide adaptors

combos.name: Rogue Combo Set - Professional Hair Clipper & Trimmer
combos.contents: Rogue magnetic-motor clipper and Rogue trimmer with guards, chargers, oil, brush and tools (charging base and modular lids sold separately).
features: 9V linear magnetic motor up to 10,000 SPM
Click lever taper, zero-gappable blade
Up to 120 min runtime
Double Black Diamond Carbon DLC Fade blade (clipper)
X-Pro Wide Gold Titanium blade + Black Diamond deep tooth cutter (trimmer)

combos.name: Protégé Combo - Professional Cordless Hair Clipper & Trimmer
combos.contents: Protégé cordless clipper (with universal 4-hole modification bracket) and Protégé cordless trimmer with removable drop-top and micro-USB chargers (charging stand sold separately).
features: Turbocharged rotary motor up to 7,000 RPM
Japanese stainless steel blades, zero-gap adjustable
Up to 240 min runtime, ~2 h charge
Micro-USB charging
Universal 4-hole bracket for most fixed blades

combos.name: Protégé Combo - Professional Cordless Hair Clipper & Trimmer
combos.contents: Gamma+ Protégé clipper (DLC Faper blade, 5 magnetic guards 1/16"-1/2", cord/adapter, cleaning kit, blade cover) and Protégé trimmer (DLC X-Pro Wide blade, "The One" cutter, cord/adapter, axis shield, blade cover).
features: Supercharged rotary motors up to 6,000 RPM
Up to 3 h lithium-ion runtime
Black Diamond DLC blades, zero-gappable
5-position click lever taper (clipper)
Removable drop-top trimmer
Low noise and vibration
